title: Bertha's Place · Seventh Ward bar & kitchen · New Orleans
description: Where customers become family, per the sign out front. Fried chicken and shrimp from behind the counter, open late Fri and Sat.
name: Bertha's Place

hero.kicker: Bar, kitchen & party room · 1355 St Bernard Ave, Seventh Ward
hero.headline: A Seventh Ward bar where the sign says customers become family and the owner introduces herself.
hero.sub: Open three nights a week and late on two of them, with fried chicken and shrimp coming out from behind the counter at prices that surprise people. The room does parties, and the owner will walk you around it.

paragraphs: The sign outside Bertha's Place carries a portrait and a line underneath it reading WHERE CUSTOMERS BECOME FAMILY. Reviewers confirm it without being prompted. A band that played a show across the street came over after their set, and the owner introduced herself, walked them around the room, and offered them her own reserved seat while they waited on food.

It is a bar and a kitchen at the same time. Fried chicken and fried shrimp come out of the back in styrofoam with fries and greens, and the thing people mention as often as the food itself is what it costs. The room does double duty for parties, which is what the balloons and the gold tablecloths in the photos are about. Doors at seven, and on Friday and Saturday it runs until three.

facts: Open Tuesday, Friday and Saturday from 7pm

A locals' room, and the owner is usually in it

order.name: A Spread for the Table

order.name: Party Platters
order.blurb: The room gets laid out for parties, gold tablecloths and all. Ask what they can do for a booking.
